notes: Region-composition check for the full page: AppShell (Sidebar + TopBar) + Masthead + CommunityRooms, real components, populated fixture data via .discipline/rendering/audit/mounts.mjs['compose-community'] — no live Supabase project reachable in this sandbox (DEVIATION-LOG.md).

Artboard order top to bottom: Masthead (VOL line, COMMUNITY title, dek, page-scoped command bar) -> 'Regional rooms' section (aside stat line) -> room tile grid, FIXED 4 columns (dc.html: grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr)), 7 room tiles + a dashed '+ New vertical group' tile as the grid's own 8th slot -> selected-room panel (GLOBAL header, Live-in-region ledger, Discussions card with composer + thread rows, foot) -> rail: Who's here, Why post here, Verifier sign-off, Vertical groups, in that order.

This lane fixed two real defects here: the room-tile grid used `repeat(auto-fit,minmax(165px,1fr))` (6 columns at 1440px, truncating theme text) instead of the artboard's fixed `repeat(4,1fr)`; and the dashed '+ New vertical group' tile — part of the SAME grid in the artboard — did not exist in the room grid at all (only a same-named trigger in the rail's Vertical groups card, kept, same handler reused).

Command bar placeholder is page-scoped: 'Search posts, groups, members — or ask "what did the EU room flag this week?"' (dc.html p12 exact text) — previously missing (generic 'Search or ask across N items…' fallback).
